name: In Falsus
source:
The second visual novel/rhythm game from the creators of the mobile game Arcaea.
In Falsus is a linear visual novel narrative told through the perspectives of 5 girls, set in a scifi world.

The people in the world wear collars called Binds that display their emotions. The Binds also enforce honesty, as all lies are detected once spoken. Above them all, a Shroud hangs over them in the sky.

The narrative begins with the main characters being convinced to join a strange organization, and shortly finding a hidden part of reality. What's more, the main protagonist quickly discovers that she seems to be able to lie without anyone knowing. The lives of the five main characters intertwine as they come to befriend one another and endure through twisted plots.
